verdict.rationale: Internet Explorer opened update.html, which launched mshta.exe to run update.hta from the IE cache. mshta then made an outbound TCP connection to internal host 10.0.2.18 on non-standard port 4443, a common signed-binary proxy-execution and C2 pattern. The trailing dllhost.exe COM Surrogate event looks benign on its own.
